title: SII Vol. 9 No. 392 — Kariyangala
location_detail: On A Stone In A Field Called Polalimaru In Kariyangala, Near Polali-Ammunaje, Mangalore Taluk, South Kanara District
date_text: The characters of the record belong to the 8th century A.D
summary: It records (that the Alupa king) Ranasagara made a gift to Nagamma of Kayra-vamsa, who was as brave as Mahendra, for crushing the army of Paybaya

title: SII Vol. 9 No. 393 — Basrur
location_detail: On A Slab Set Up In The Prakara Of Mahalingesvara Temple At Basrur, Coondapur Taluk, Same District
date_text: The record is dated Saka 1077, Bhava, the month Dhanus and Sankrmana
summary: The inscription belongs to the reign of the Alupa king Kaviyalupendra

title: SII Vol. 9 No. 394
location_detail: On Another Slab In The Same Place
summary: This is damaged record belongs to the reign of the Alupa king Pandyachakravarti Kulasekharadeva and his dated the cyclic year Manmatha, Makara, 18, Somavara corresponding probably to A.D. 1176 January 12 Monday

title: SII Vol. 9 No. 395 — Kotesvara
location_detail: On A Slab Set Up On The East Side Of The Inner Prakara Of The Kotesvara Temple At Kotesvara, A Suburb Of Coondapur, Same Taluk And District
summary: This is dated Saka 1183, Durmati, Margasira, su. 6 Man[galavara*] and Dhanurmasa 3, Jupiter in Makara, corresponding to A.D. 1261 November 27 Tuesday

title: SII Vol. 9 No. 396
location_detail: On A Slab Set Up In The Prakara Of The Kundesvara Temple At The Same Village
summary: This is dated Saka 1184, Dundubhi, Sravana, ba. 13, Adivara corresponding to A.D. 1262 August 13, Sunday in the reign of Pattamahadevi and king Pandyadev-Alpendradevarasa

title: SII Vol. 9 No. 397 — Kotesvara
location_detail: On A Slab Set Up In The North Veranda Of The Inner Prakara In The Kotesvara Temple At Kotesvara, Same Taluk And District
summary: It refers to Pandyachakravarti Viradevalva and registers a gift of paddy for the service of god Narayanadeva

title: SII Vol. 9 No. 398 — Polali Ammunaje
location_detail: On A Piece Of Carved Slab Lying Near The Dhavajastambha Of Durga-Paramesvari Temple At Polali Ammunaje, Mangalore Taluk, Same District
summary: It belongs to the reign of Kulase[khara] Pandyapattigadeva and mentions Biravadi and Melavadi
